name: AI agent tool use
description: Reference Trust Requirements Profile for an AI agent that plans steps and calls tools on a user's behalf, independent of the model or framework behind it. Illustrative draft values.

scope.intended_use: Trust requirements for one AI agent completing a task with tools, such as search, files, code and outbound messages.
scope.boundary: A single agent task from the user's request to the agent's final output.
out_of_scope: How the system is scored against these signals
How a halt or other action is enforced
Which model or agent framework is used

scored_signals.reason: Runaway step counts point to loops, confusion or a task the agent should hand back.
Repeated tool failures mean the agent is acting on broken information.
Pulling more data than the task needs is how private data leaks.
Answers that cannot be traced to sources should not be trusted.
Spend far above normal is an early sign of a runaway agent.

standing_bands.range: all signals within acceptable range and no hard rule met
one or more signals in the warning range
a signal in the critical range or a hard rule met

required_standing.source_requirement: For audit or insurance use, the evaluation source should be independent of the agent and its developer.

notes: Threshold values are illustrative draft values.
This profile is framework agnostic. Any agent runtime can report these signals.
